placements.why: All three assertions narrate the same realized mechanism this leaf already holds: the product capturing decisions at the moment of consensus. src-1 reports the widget that performs that capture as shipped; src-3 names the Zephyr integration as the technical enabler that lets capture happen inside the chat surfaces where consensus occurs (Slack/Teams/Discord), directly extending the leaf's 'captures the decision at the moment' framing; src-2's record velocity is offered as the proof-point that this capture mechanism, once shipped, accelerated delivery — evidence for the leaf's ongoing claim rather than a theme of its own. No existing leaf about team execution or integrations is supplied, and the grain test rules out minting a leaf for a one-time velocity metric or a single integration name; both are evidence, not subjects.
